text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I could never bring myself
to claim I was the strongest or number one, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“If we could win the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...
that'd be nice.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can definitely say
that I'm number one at middle distance, right...!
“The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is a medium-distance race boasting supreme tradition and prestige among GⅠs. If you can win this, you'll be a top-class Umamusume in both name and reality!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the top spot... yeeeah!
Oooh...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, hold it in, mouth of mine!
I'm not taking it back today...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no no no... No!
N-N... No!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You don't have to tell me!
